title: Test Your Sales IQ: 10 Core Sales Concepts
summary: The creator presents a 10-topic checklist to test one's sales IQ, ranging from mirroring and labeling to win-loss analysis. Commenting 'SALES' will prompt the creator to send a compiled PDF containing all these topics.
key_points: Mirroring and Labelling: Reflecting someone's feelings back and putting emotions into words to build trust and connection.
Losing to No Decision: Recognizing that indecision keeps you stuck, wastes opportunities, and pushes you away from goals.
Reframing the Customer's Problem: Looking at the customer's situation from a different angle to uncover real needs and create better solutions.
The Six Principles of Influence: Using principles like reciprocity, commitment, social proof, authority, liking, and scarcity to influence decisions.
Signal-based Selling: Paying attention to buying signals and cues in conversations to guide the right offer and close.
Champion-led Building: Identifying internal champions who believe in your solution to gain advocacy and increase closing chances.
Giving the Buyer an 'Out': Giving the buyer a way to say no or pause to reduce pressure, build trust, and maintain control.
Pricing by Value, Not by Hour: Focusing on value and results created for the customer to position yourself as an expert and increase perceived worth.
Mutual Action Plans: Creating an agreed-upon plan with the buyer detailing next steps and responsibilities to build accountability and momentum.
Win-Loss Analysis: Reviewing wins and losses to improve future sales outcomes.
